title: CSS Challenge: Build a Responsive Interface
description: Synthesize CSS fundamentals: combine Box Model sizing, typography hierarchy, Flexbox header alignment, CSS Grid content layout, and mobile-first media queries to build a production-grade responsive card portal.

objectives.statement: Integrate Flexbox and CSS Grid into a unified responsive web layout.
Apply box model sizing, typography hierarchy, and min-width media queries to satisfy layout specifications.

content.title: Synthesis Challenge: Responsive Analytics Portal
content.hook: You've mastered CSS selectors, cascade resolution, box model mechanics, Flexbox alignment, CSS Grid layouts, and responsive media queries. Now put it all together to build a complete responsive UI.
content.context: Your task is to build a responsive portal interface featuring a Flexbox navigation header, a fluid hero section, and a 3-card responsive CSS grid that adapts seamlessly from phone to desktop viewports.
goals: Build a Flexbox navigation header with spaced elements.
Build a responsive CSS Grid content layout that stacks on mobile and splits into columns on desktop.
Pass all automated DOM verification test cases.

content.title: Build the Responsive Analytics Portal
content.prompt:
Complete the CSS stylesheet to build the portal:
1. Add universal reset `* { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }`.
2. On `.header`, apply `display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding: 1rem 2rem; background: #0f172a; color: #ffffff;`.
3. On `.cards-grid`, apply `display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 1.5rem; padding: 2rem;` for mobile.
4. Add a media query `@media (min-width: 768px)` so `.cards-grid` expands to `grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr)`.
5. On `.card`, apply `background: #ffffff; padding: 1.5rem; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0,0,0,0.05);`.

feedback.correct: Congratulations! You have successfully built a fully responsive production UI synthesizing Box Model, Flexbox, Grid, and Media Queries!
feedback.incorrect: Check your styles: universal border-box reset, .header flexbox space-between, .cards-grid display: grid with gap, .card background/radius/shadow, and @media (min-width: 768px) grid columns.

hints.content: Add `* { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }` at the top of your style block.
Define `.header { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding: 1rem 2rem; background: #0f172a; color: #ffffff; }`.
Define `.cards-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 1.5rem; padding: 2rem; }` and `@media (min-width: 768px) { .cards-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); } }`.

content.prompt: Reflecting on this challenge, how do Flexbox, CSS Grid, and Media Queries work together to create maintainable, professional layout architectures?

feedback.correct: Excellent architectural reflection! Flexbox handles 1D row/column component distribution (headers, buttons, badges), CSS Grid establishes 2D page track structures (dashboards, card lists), and Media Queries smoothly reshape these tracks across device screen widths.
feedback.incorrect: Summarize how Flexbox (1D alignment), Grid (2D structure), and Media Queries (responsive breakpoints) complement each other.

content.title: Module Completed: CSS Fundamentals!
takeaways: Universal box-sizing: border-box eliminates layout calculation bugs.
Flexbox manages 1D navigation alignment and button spacing.
CSS Grid establishes flexible 2D page layouts with fr tracks and gap gutters.
Mobile-first min-width media queries progressively adapt desktop structures without code duplication.
